content:
Successful HWPX document manipulation requires precise XML namespace management, text run consolidation, and layout cache invalidation.
The process successfully replaced placeholders by concatenating split text runs within <hp:p> elements and clearing redundant <hp:t> nodes. Critical rendering issues were avoided by removing <hp:linesegarray> elements to force HWP to recalculate layout. Namespace integrity was maintained using etree.register_namespace, while custom regex logic correctly handled digit extraction and string formatting.
